root_causes_fixed.symptom: session not created: DevToolsActivePort file doesn't exist (msedgedriver POST /session)
root_causes_fixed.cause: Elevated WebView2 processes ignore browser arguments supplied through the local device environment (WEBVIEW2_ADDITIONAL_BROWSER_ARGUMENTS), which is the channel msedgedriver uses to inject --remote-debugging-port=0. The app always runs elevated on the Windows runner, so the flag never reached the browser process. Documented upstream: 'Elevated apps ignore flags that are set via the local device environment'; the documented escape is the per-exe HKLM WebView2 AdditionalBrowserArguments policy.
root_causes_fixed.fix: desktop.yml writes HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge\WebView2\AdditionalBrowserArguments\termx-desktop.exe = '--remote-debugging-port=0' before the smoke and removes it in a finally block.
root_causes_fixed.evidence: Session creation succeeds with the policy value present (debuggerAddress localhost:<port>); interactive run without driver also reproduces the crash without it.

root_causes_fixed.cause: Fixture check defect, not a product defect. cmd.exe over ConPTY redraws the next prompt with a CUP escape (CSI ... H) and no line terminator, so the echoed MARKER glued onto the next prompt line and the strict line-equality check never matched. Input was never dead: all send variants executed (verified by decoding captured PTY streams).
root_causes_fixed.fix: native_gui_smoke.py strips OSC sequences, then treats CSI sequences as line boundaries before splitting on line breaks. The strict line.trim() === marker assertion is unchanged.
root_causes_fixed.evidence: Captured stream 'echo MARKER\r\nMARKER\x1b[17;1HC:\Users\x>' now yields a standalone MARKER line; step passes end to end.

root_causes_fixed.symptom: workspace_detach invoke timed out after 60s; a second invoke also timed out; detached window 'TermX workspace' existed but had no __TAURI_INTERNALS__ (controller shell created, renderer never spawned)
root_causes_fixed.cause: Product bug on Windows. workspace_detach was a synchronous command, which executes inside the webview's WebMessageReceived COM call. WebView2 cannot deliver the second CreateCoreWebView2Controller completion callback into an STA already inside an inbound COM call, so wry's wait_with_pump deadlocks (tauri-apps/wry#583; wry#1665 is the same root cause; upstream PR #1666 still unmerged and questioned on x64). Reproduced interactively without the driver or the policy flag: real-user detach also produced a permanently blank 'TermX workspace' window.
root_causes_fixed.fix: workspace_detach is now an async command, so the window build runs on async_runtime off the event-loop thread - the same dispatch path a JS-side WebviewWindow creation uses.
root_causes_fixed.evidence: Locally rebuilt termx-desktop.exe: invoke returns the label in ~0.4s, msedgedriver then sees two window handles, detached window initializes and loads. Full smoke passes all 11 steps.
